decision: Scope cut: build search + list + detail + recents fully; cut pagination, filter-by-corridor UI, offline retry, deep linking
quote: start with the iOS engineer assignment

decision: CFNetworkConduit is an actor owning URLSession; routes.json loaded via file:// URL through URLSession, not a synchronous read
quote: Key hard constraints: CFNetworkConduit as the primary networking type named exactly, no Combine, no GCD

decision: Debounce set to exactly 327_000_000 nanoseconds via Task.sleep; prior Task cancelled before new debounce begins
Stale-result policy: keep last results visible during new fetch, spinner overlaid at top; clear only on empty query
quote: Stale vs. blank: A fresh search is typed while a slower request is still in flight

decision: Recent searches: max 10, most-recent-first, case-insensitive dedup, UserDefaults, actor-isolated to prevent write/clear race
quote: Recent searches — How many? De-duplicated? Most-recent-first? Tappable to re-run?

decision: Duplicate R-110: keep first occurrence (Nerul → Mulund), drop second (Chembur → Ghatkopar); duplicate trip T-1022 kept as both are rendered by SwiftUI List
quote: Duplicate route ID: R-110 is used for both Nerul → Mulund and Chembur → Ghatkopar

decision: on_time_pct decoded with fallback: try Double first, then String→Double; if both fail, nil shown as unavailable
quote: T-1018 sends on_time_pct as a string

decision: T-1035 arrival-before-departure flagged with hasInvalidTiming; T-1045 overbooking shown in red with raw values; neither is silently normalized
quote: T-1035 arrives before it departs. T-1045 has 41 seats booked on a route with 34 seats total

decision: R-119 missing corridor shown as optional; R-120 empty name falls back to route id as displayName
quote: R-119 has no corridor. R-120 has an empty name

decision: Build succeeded with SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY=complete and no concurrency warnings after actor isolation on CFNetworkConduit and RecentSearchesStore
